problem_statement: langgptai aurora-landing ships the 口袋AI (PocketAI) marketing landing page, a Next.js 15 App Router site for a fictional Chinese AI conversation assistant. The site already ships one coherent product design system: a shared fixed masthead nav that lists the site's sections (主页, 特性, 开发者, 下载) where every rendered nav anchor carries a shared nav-link class, a shared media-block/h3-title/tagline/description card pattern, and a shared footer chrome. The site ships real product media in /public (landing_p1.png, landing_p2.png, landing_p3.png, appshots.png, p-1.png and download_qr.png) but never surfaces those product assets in a browsable gallery. The 口袋AI team wants a public 产品素材 (Product Assets) gallery that lets visitors BROWSE the real product screenshots, key visual and download material by category, in the site's own design system. Build a 产品素材 gallery section that reuses the shared card pattern and, at its head, a NATIVE category filter — a tab row (全部 / 界面 / 视觉 / 物料) with a live result-count readout in the form '展示 N / 6 · <类别>' — so clicking a category re-renders the asset cards to just that category AND updates the count. Mount the gallery on the Home overview (so the filter rides the main page) and also expose it on a dedicated 产品素材 page at the /showcase route composed from the SAME shared masthead nav and footer chrome, and register a '产品素材' entry in the shared nav so the nav-link renders consistently in the section nav on every page (the Home page and the showcase page), not only on the showcase page itself. When a category tab is clicked the readout must re-derive from the live filter (never a snapshot frozen at mount). Use grounded 口袋AI asset copy (real product screenshots and the actual public image filenames) rather than generic filler; keep the gallery, its category tab row and the card grid free of horizontal overflow on desktop and 390px mobile (the tab row must wrap, not overrun the viewport, and the cards must not shingle or clip); and do not diverge into an off-system one-off page (a bespoke teal standalone header, inline-styled div rows, no shared card grid) or break the shared cross-page navigation.
required_content: Add a 产品素材 (Product Assets) gallery built from the site's shared card pattern with a NATIVE category filter at its head: a tab row (全部 / 界面 / 视觉 / 物料) and a live result-count readout '展示 N / 6 · <类别>' that re-renders the asset cards and updates the count when a category is clicked.

Expose the gallery on the Home overview AND on a dedicated 产品素材 page at the /showcase route, both composed from the shared masthead nav and footer chrome and the shared media-block/h3-title/tagline/description card grid so the page is visually indistinguishable in system from the Home page.
Register a '产品素材' entry in the shared nav so the nav-link renders consistently in the section nav on the Home page and the showcase page, not only on the showcase page.

Populate the gallery with grounded 口袋AI product media (real product screenshots, the key visual and the download QR referenced by their actual /public filenames, at least six asset cards) rather than generic demo filler.
Clicking a category tab must re-derive the shown cards and the count readout from the live filter (never a value snapshotted at mount), so the readout always matches the cards shown.

Keep the gallery, its category tab row and the card grid free of horizontal overflow at 390px mobile — the tab row must wrap and the cards must not shingle or clip — and keep the existing Home overview intact.
design_constraints: Build the 产品素材 gallery and its category filter from the shared masthead nav and footer chrome and the shared media-block/h3-title/tagline/description card pattern, not a standalone page with bespoke inline markup.
The category filter is a real control: clicking a tab must re-filter the cards AND update the '展示 N / 6' count from the live filter state, not from a value frozen at mount.
Register '产品素材' in the shared nav so the section nav stays consistent on every page rather than the new page existing in isolation.
Keep the tab row and card grid responsive: the tab row wraps on mobile (no fixed non-wrapping width) and the cards keep readable contrast and never shingle, overlap or clip off the edge.

Do not introduce off-system styling (a one-off bespoke teal inline-styled header, inline-styled div rows, a separate standalone page with no shared card grid) or remove sections from the existing Home overview.
state_constraints: desktop_showcase verifies the 产品素材 showcase page renders through the shared design system: the shared card grid produces at least six h3 asset titles, the shared masthead nav with the registered 产品素材 nav-link is present, and the shared footer is present.
mobile_showcase verifies the showcase page holds the same shared card grid at 390px.

desktop_asset_filter verifies the native category filter is a real control: clicking the 界面 tab re-renders the cards and the count readout re-derives to '展示 3 / 6 · 界面' (changed from '展示 6 / 6 · 全部'), so a frozen/stale readout is rejected.

desktop_home verifies the shared section nav now lists the 产品素材 nav-link consistently on a page other than the showcase page, the shared gallery card grid renders, and the existing Home overview is unchanged.
mobile_home verifies the gallery, its category tab row and the card grid hold at 390px without horizontal overflow (the tab row wraps and the cards do not shingle or clip).

change_completion: The 产品素材 gallery exists on the Home overview and at the /showcase route and presents grounded 口袋AI product media with real product screenshots and their actual public image filenames.
A native category filter (tab row + '展示 N / 6 · <类别>' count readout) sits at the head of the gallery and re-renders the asset cards on click.
A 产品素材 entry is registered in the shared nav.
design_consistency: The gallery reuses the shared masthead nav and the shared card pattern and type scale and is indistinguishable in system from the Home page.
The 产品素材 nav-link renders consistently across the Home page and the showcase page, not only on the showcase page.
regression: The existing Home overview remains intact with its content and the shared masthead nav and footer chrome.
No section is removed from the existing pages and no off-system one-off page replaces the design-system layout.
responsive: The gallery, its category tab row and the card grid render at 390px mobile without extra horizontal overflow — the tab row wraps and the cards do not shingle or clip.
Clicking a category tab keeps the count readout in sync with the cards actually shown.

author_notes: Add a coherent 产品素材 (Product Assets) gallery to the 口袋AI aurora-landing site with a NATIVE category filter (a 全部/界面/视觉/物料 tab row + a live '展示 N / 6 · <类别>' result count) that re-renders the shared asset cards on click. The gallery reuses the shared masthead nav, footer chrome and media-block/h3-title/tagline/description card pattern, is mounted on the Home overview and on the /showcase page, and registers a 产品素材 entry in the shared nav so the nav-link appears in the section nav on every page. It is fed by the real 口袋AI product media (landing_p1/p2/p3.png, appshots.png, p-1.png, download_qr.png). INFRA (identical across all legs, NOT part of the task content): the next/font/google Inter web font is replaced with a local system font stack so the site builds and serves fully offline; each rendered section-nav anchor is given a shared nav-link class so a registered nav link is machine-detectable; and the Home sections' decorative absolutely-positioned backdrops (a conic-gradient spinner and large blurred gradient circles) are clipped at their decorative hosts (section:not(#showcase), .-z-10) so the graded gallery's horizontal overflow is measurable at tolerance 24 without clamping the document. The baseline ships the gallery with CORRECT filter wiring (its count readout re-derives on click, so it passes the interaction gate) but two original defects: its category tab row uses a fixed non-wrapping width so the tab row overruns the 390px viewport (horizontal overflow) and the header layout regresses visually, and it never registers 产品素材 in the shared nav nor exposes a shared /showcase page, so the nav-link is absent cross-page. The bad solution is a smart-wrong attempt: its Home gallery snapshots the filtered cards and the count readout once at mount, so clicking a category tab moves the active-tab highlight but the readout stays frozen on '展示 6 / 6 · 全部' (a stale-state filtering bug — the interaction succeeds but the result never changes); its gallery CSS shingles the cards with negative margins and renders the active tab and card titles at near-invisible contrast (a broken, illegible layout) and overruns the mobile viewport; and it ships an off-system standalone /showcase page (a bespoke teal '口袋AI Showcase Cheatsheet' with a 'Back to home' link, inline-styled div rows, no shared card grid or masthead nav) and never registers 产品素材 in the shared nav. The gates discriminate exactly this: the reference passes all four leverage gates; the baseline fails horizontal-overflow, visual-regression and the cross-page dom_assertions but passes the interaction gate; and the bad solution fails all four.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: langgptai aurora-landing ships the 口袋AI Chinese AI-conversation-assistant marketing landing (Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind) whose Home page already ships a consistent product design system (a shared masthead nav where every anchor carries a nav-link class, a shared media/h3/tagline/description card pattern, and a shared footer) and ships real product media in /public; a content_asset_continuity Consistency task to ADD a browsable 产品素材 (Product Assets) gallery with a native category filter that must conform to that existing design system across pages (including registering the link in a shared cross-page section nav) without diverging into an off-system one-off layout, freezing the filter's result count, or breaking the shared navigation.
